name: 許書涵
objective: 先修課程：負責教授同意。物質熱力學特性、改變能量形式之基本原理、熱力學第一及第二定律、可逆性與可用性、動力循環、冷凍循環、混合氣、化學反應。
schedule:
Week Topic (Sections)
1 Introduction, Definitions, Units, Systems (1.1-1.3)
Properties, State, Processes, Cycles (1.4-1.7)
State postulate, Temperature (1.8-1.9)
Pressure, Problem-Solving, Energy (1.10-1.13, 2.1)
2 Heat Transfer, Work (2.2-2.4)
3 The First Law of Thermodynamics (2.5)
Energy Conversion Efficiencies (2.6)
4 Pure Substance, Phase-Change (3.1-3.3)
5 Property Diagrams (3.4)
Thermodynamic Property Tables ( 3.5)
6 Moving Boundary Work (4.1)
Energy Balance for Closed Systems (4.2)
7 Specific Heats (4.3)
Internal Energy, Enthalpy, Specific Heats for Ideal Gases (4.4)
8 Midterm Exam
9. Internal Energy, Enthalpy, Specific Heats of Solids and Liquids (4.5)
10 Mass Balance for Control Volumes (5.1)
Flow Work and the Energy of a Flowing Fluid (5.2)
11 Energy Balance for Steady-Flow Systems (5.3)
12. Some Steady-Flow Engineering Devices (5.4)
Nozzles, Diffusers, Turbines, Compressors (5.4)
13
14 Throttling valves, Mixing chambers, Heat exchangers, Pipe and duct flow (5.4)
15 Unsteady-flow process (5.5)
Introduction to the Second law, Thermal Reservoirs (6.1-6.2)
16 Final Exam
scorePolicy:
平時成績 30%
期中考 35%
期末考 35%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】



Cengel, Yunus A., and Boles, Michael A., Thermodynamics An Engineering Approach, Ninth Edition, McGraw-Hill, 2019.
consultation:
有課程問題可直接在賴群組諮詢，或寄信詢問。
週間正常課餘時間皆可事先預約諮詢學業問題。
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）
課程是否導入AI:
● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）
● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
